pairs.registryProposal: The 2026-10-03 verdict called promotion-lifecycle conformant because the tag column has declared states and an atomic single-production swap. But the runtime reads the personas row, not the tag, and a save path (accept-draft) moves that row without touching the tag. promotion-lifecycle could name this shape outright: a state column that is not the pointer the runtime reads is a second, decorative authority, and a judge that checks only the column will pass it.
